description: This is a Java test class named 'AmqpConnectionIT' that contains integration tests for verifying AMQP connection behaviors, such as connection success for registered devices, failure for invalid credentials, unknown devices, disabled adapters, invalid usernames, and trust anchor validation, within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AmqpConnectionIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 integration test class for testing AMQP connection scenarios in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, primarily logging the current test's display name.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Cleans up resources by closing the connection after each test.

methods.name: testConnectSucceedsForRegisteredDevice
methods.description: Verifies that a known device with correct credentials can establish a connection successfully.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Ensures connection is refused when an unknown device attempts to connect.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForWrongCredentials
methods.description: Checks that devices with incorrect passwords are rejected.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Verifies connection refusal when the tenant's AMQP adapter is disabled.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDeletedDevices
methods.description: Ensures that devices which have been deregistered cannot connect.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForInvalidUsernamePattern
methods.description: Verifies failure when a device attempts to connect with a username that does not match the expected pattern.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForNonMatchingTrustAnchor
methods.description: Checks that connection fails when the device's client certificate cannot be validated against the tenant's trust anchor.
